feeding_claim.verbatim: Our animals are all raised on our land, moving around the pasture grazing and foraging.

notes: On-the-farm meat market in Townsend; winter hours Saturday to Monday 10 am to 4 pm per contact page. About page says the farm also makes its own supplemental feed from farm-grown corn and seeds, so beef is not grass-only. Poultry and eggs described as pasture-raised; pork and beef described as natural. Bulk beef (whole, half, quarter) reserved by contacting the farm; pork halves and quarters in the online store. Site names no delivery or shipping; the Barn2Door store did not render, so Verifier should check its fulfillment options. No phone on site.
